question: In which year was the First National Forest Policy issued by the Government of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1952.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **National Forest Policy of 1952** states that forests must **cover 33% of the land **area to maintain** ecological balance.**
 
• It suggested **dividing forests **into three categories: **protection forests, national forests, and village forests.**
